description:
Genes with a known function for a trait in Arabidopsis and their Brassica orthologues: TAIR mutant phenotypes,
curator summaries and GO biological-process terms (experimental evidence marked) matching the trait words, ranked
by evidence (the trait written as a phrase, mutant lines, summary, experimental GO, publications), each with its orthologues in B. napus, B. rapa R-o-18, B. oleracea, B. juncea, Camelina, A. lyrata and A. halleri
from Ensembl Compara (type one2one/one2many/many2many and identity). trait: words ('flowering time',
'seed size', 'nodule'; use Arabidopsis wording, e.g. 'silique dehiscence' for pod shatter); species: one Ensembl genome to keep (e.g. 'brassica_napus', 'brassica_oleracea').
Function in the crop is inferred from Arabidopsis: say so and give the orthology type.
name: arabidopsis_trait_genes
